description: Trace the full impact of a proposed change or deletion before anything is edited. Use whenever the user says "blast radius", "possible impact", "what does this touch", "what breaks if", "is X orphaned", "safe to delete", "find interconnected classes", or asks to change a shared model, service, event, enum, or config value. Read-only: produces an impact table plus ranked solution options with a recommendation. Never applies the change itself. Required before any modification to code used by more than one feature.
